CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFINSERT

CFINSERT is the lazy programmer's INSERT statement. It looks at the columns of the table, finds the form fields with the same names, and adds one row built from their values.

Category

Database manipulation

Syntax

<CFINSERT DATASOURCE="ds_name"
    TABLENAME="table_name"
    TABLEOWNER="owner"
    TABLEQUALIFIER="qualifier"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    FORMFIELDS="field_names">

Attributes

DATASOURCE
Required. Data source that holds the table.
TABLENAME
Required. Table to insert into.
FORMFIELDS
Optional, default all fields. Comma-separated list of form fields to insert. Without it, every name in Form.FieldNames that matches a column is used.
TABLEOWNER
Optional. Owner of the table on servers that support owners. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
TABLEQUALIFIER
Optional. Database or schema qualifier. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
USERNAME
Optional. Overrides the user name stored with the data source. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
PASSWORD
Optional. Overrides the password stored with the data source. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

Field names are matched to column names without regard to case. Fields with no matching column (such as the Submit button) are skipped, and so are COUNTER (autonumber) columns, which the database fills in. An empty field bound for a numeric column is stored as NULL. If not a single field matches a column, a Database exception is thrown.

To find the key of the row you just added, run SELECT MAX(id_column) (or SELECT @@IDENTITY) in a CFQUERY straight afterwards. For full control over the SQL, use CFQUERY with CFQUERYPARAM.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFIF IsDefined("Form.FromUser")>
  <CFINSERT DATASOURCE="cfsnippets" TABLENAME="Comments"
            FORMFIELDS="FromUser,Email,Subject,CommtType,MessText">
  <CFQUERY NAME="Newest" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
  SELECT MAX(CommentID) AS LastID FROM Comments
  </CFQUERY>
  <CFQUERY NAME="Added" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
  SELECT * FROM Comments WHERE CommentID = #Newest.LastID#
  </CFQUERY>
  <CFOUTPUT QUERY="Added">
  <P>Thank you! Comment ###CommentID# was stored:</P>
  <TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
  <TR><TD>From</TD><TD>#HTMLEditFormat(FromUser)# (#HTMLEditFormat(Email)#)</TD></TR>
  <TR><TD>Subject</TD><TD>#HTMLEditFormat(Subject)# [#CommtType#]</TD></TR>
  <TR><TD>Message</TD><TD>#HTMLEditFormat(MessText)#</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
  </CFOUTPUT>
  <!--- Tidy up, so the next visitor finds the table as it was --->
  <CFQUERY DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
  DELETE FROM Comments WHERE CommentID = #Newest.LastID#
  </CFQUERY>
  <P>(The row has been removed again.) <A HREF="cfinsert.cfm">Try again</A></P>
<CFELSE>
  <FORM ACTION="cfinsert.cfm" METHOD="POST">
  Name: <INPUT TYPE="Text" NAME="FromUser" VALUE="Pat Kowal"><BR>
  Email: <INPUT TYPE="Text" NAME="Email" VALUE="pat@localhost"><BR>
  Subject: <INPUT TYPE="Text" NAME="Subject" VALUE="Nice site"><BR>
  Type: <SELECT NAME="CommtType"><OPTION>Praise<OPTION>Question<OPTION>Bug Report</SELECT><BR>
  <TEXTAREA NAME="MessText" ROWS=3 COLS=40>Loads fast even on my 56K modem.</TEXTAREA><BR>
  <INPUT TYPE="Submit" VALUE="Insert comment">
  </FORM>
</CFIF>
